neighbours.label: the thing or service provided in a supplying / serving construction ("leading suppliers for the garrison", "provides lamp oil", "guide for his explorations")
fire: During the war the family were the chief suppliers for the navy yard.
The coconut palm provides cooking oil, rope and roofing material.
Lewis hired a trapper to act as guide for his journey up the river.
The monastery supplied candles and bread for the pilgrims.
Local farmers became key providers of meat for the garrison.
Bamboo also provides fuel, paper and building poles for the villagers.
She was engaged as interpreter for his travels in Persia.
The mill was the leading supplier of flour for the colony.
quiet: During the war the family lived next to the navy yard.
The coconut palm grows well on sandy beaches near the sea.
Lewis met a trapper on his journey up the river.
The monastery stood on a hill above the pilgrims' road.
Local farmers often complained about the garrison's noise.
Bamboo also grows quickly in the wet hills near the villages.
She kept a diary of his travels in Persia.
The mill was the oldest building in the colony.

notes: Low confidence. In the probe, 'suppliers for the fort' scored 0.46 of max, 'provides lamp oil' 0.30, 'guide for his' 0.28, 'brought a message' 0.16 and 'witness of the light' 0.07, while the non-provision twins scored about 0.02-0.03. Near misses keep the subjects but drop the provision.
